```rust
pub enum IRNode {
    // 리터럴
    IntLiteral(i64),
    FloatLiteral(f64),
    StringLiteral(String),
    BoolLiteral(bool),

    // 변수
    Variable(String),

    // 연산
    BinaryOp { op, left, right },
    UnaryOp { op, operand },

    // 제어 흐름
    If { condition, then_block, else_block },

    // 함수
    FunctionCall { name, args },

    // 배열/튜플
    Array { elements },
    Index { expr, index },
    Tuple { elements },

    // 변수 할당
    Assign { name, value },

    // 반환
    Return(Box<IRNode>),

    // 다중 명령
    Block(Vec<IRNode>),
}
```

#### 주요 메서드
- `returns_value()`: 값을 반환하는지 확인
- `fold_constants()`: 상수 폴딩 (컴파일 타임 계산)
- `eliminate_dead_code()`: 불필요한 코드 제거

### 2. 최적화 기법

#### 상수 폴딩 (Constant Folding)
```
1 + 2 → 3 (컴파일 타임에 계산)
true && false → false
-5 → -5
```

#### 불필요한 코드 제거 (Dead Code Elimination)
```
let unused = 42;  // 사용되지 않으면 제거
let used = 10;
x = used;         // 유지
```

#### 조건 단순화 (Constant Condition Simplification)
```
if (true) {
    block_a
} else {
    block_b
}
↓
block_a  // 직접 실행
```

### 3. IRFunction 및 IRProgram

```rust
pub struct IRFunction {
    pub name: String,
    pub params: Vec<(String, Type)>,
    pub return_type: Type,
    pub body: Vec<IRNode>,
}

pub struct IRProgram {
    pub functions: Vec<IRFunction>,
    pub main: Vec<IRNode>,
}
```

```rust
pub enum IRNode {
    // 값
    IntLiteral(i64),
    FloatLiteral(f64),
    StringLiteral(String),
    BoolLiteral(bool),

    // 변수
    Variable(String),

    // 연산
    BinaryOp {
        op: String,

        name: String,
        args: Vec<IRNode>,

        elements: Vec<IRNode>,

        index: Box<IRNode>,

}

pub struct IRProgram {
    pub functions: Vec<IRFunction>,

### 1. IR 정의 (src/ir.rs, 500+ 줄)

#### IRNode enum (10개 변종)
```rust
pub enum IRNode {
    // 리터럴
    IntLiteral(i64),
    FloatLiteral(f64),
    StringLiteral(String),
    BoolLiteral(bool),

    // 변수
    Variable(String),

    // 연산
    BinaryOp { op, left, right },
    UnaryOp { op, operand },

    // 제어 흐름
    If { condition, then_block, else_block },

    // 함수
    FunctionCall { name, args },

    // 배열/튜플
    Array { elements },
    Index { expr, index },
    Tuple { elements },

    // 변수 할당
    Assign { name, value },

    // 반환
    Return(Box<IRNode>),

    // 다중 명령
    Block(Vec<IRNode>),
}
```

#### 주요 메서드
- `returns_value()`: 값을 반환하는지 확인
- `fold_constants()`: 상수 폴딩 (컴파일 타임 계산)
- `eliminate_dead_code()`: 불필요한 코드 제거

### 2. 최적화 기법

#### 상수 폴딩 (Constant Folding)
```
1 + 2 → 3 (컴파일 타임에 계산)
true && false → false
-5 → -5
```

#### 불필요한 코드 제거 (Dead Code Elimination)
```
let unused = 42;  // 사용되지 않으면 제거
let used = 10;
x = used;         // 유지
```

#### 조건 단순화 (Constant Condition Simplification)
```
if (true) {
    block_a
} else {
    block_b
}
↓
block_a  // 직접 실행
```

### 3. IRFunction 및 IRProgram

```rust
pub struct IRFunction {
    pub name: String,
    pub params: Vec<(String, Type)>,
    pub return_type: Type,
    pub body: Vec<IRNode>,
}

pub struct IRProgram {
    pub functions: Vec<IRFunction>,
    pub main: Vec<IRNode>,
}
```

#### IRNode enum (10개 변종)
```rust
pub enum IRNode {
    // 리터럴
    IntLiteral(i64),
    FloatLiteral(f64),
    StringLiteral(String),
    BoolLiteral(bool),

    // 변수
    Variable(String),

    // 연산
    BinaryOp { op, left, right },
    UnaryOp { op, operand },

    // 제어 흐름
    If { condition, then_block, else_block },

    // 함수
    FunctionCall { name, args },

    // 배열/튜플
    Array { elements },
    Index { expr, index },
    Tuple { elements },

    // 변수 할당
    Assign { name, value },

    // 반환
    Return(Box<IRNode>),

    // 다중 명령
    Block(Vec<IRNode>),
}
```

#### 주요 메서드
- `returns_value()`: 값을 반환하는지 확인
- `fold_constants()`: 상수 폴딩 (컴파일 타임 계산)
- `eliminate_dead_code()`: 불필요한 코드 제거

### 2. 최적화 기법

#### 상수 폴딩 (Constant Folding)
```
1 + 2 → 3 (컴파일 타임에 계산)
true && false → false
-5 → -5
```

#### 불필요한 코드 제거 (Dead Code Elimination)
```
let unused = 42;  // 사용되지 않으면 제거
let used = 10;
x = used;         // 유지
```

#### 조건 단순화 (Constant Condition Simplification)
```
if (true) {
    block_a
} else {
    block_b
}
↓
block_a  // 직접 실행
```

### 3. IRFunction 및 IRProgram

```rust
pub struct IRFunction {
    pub name: String,
    pub params: Vec<(String, Type)>,
    pub return_type: Type,
    pub body: Vec<IRNode>,
}

pub struct IRProgram {
    pub functions: Vec<IRFunction>,
    pub main: Vec<IRNode>,
}
```

pub fn ast_to_ir(&mut self, program: &Program) -> Result<IRProgram, CompileError> {
    let mut functions = Vec::new();
    for definition in &program.definitions {

            Definition::Function { name, params, body } => {
                let ir_body: Vec<_> = body
                    .iter()
                    .map(|stmt| self.statement_to_ir(stmt))
                    .collect::<Result<Vec<_>, _>>()?;

                    name: name.clone(),
                    params: params
                        .iter()
                        .map(|p| (p.clone(), Type::Unknown))
                        .collect(),
                    return_type: Type::Unknown,
                    body: ir_body,
                };
                functions.push(ir_func);
            }

        }
    }
    Ok(IRProgram { functions, main: vec![] })
}

```rust
pub fn ast_to_ir(&mut self, program: &Program) -> Result<IRProgram, CompileError> {
    let mut functions = Vec::new();
    for definition in &program.definitions {
        match definition {
            Definition::Function { name, params, body } => {
                let ir_body: Vec<_> = body
                    .iter()
                    .map(|stmt| self.statement_to_ir(stmt))
                    .collect::<Result<Vec<_>, _>>()?;

                let ir_func = IRFunction {
                    name: name.clone(),
                    params: params
                        .iter()
                        .map(|p| (p.clone(), Type::Unknown))
                        .collect(),
                    return_type: Type::Unknown,
                    body: ir_body,
                };
                functions.push(ir_func);
            }
            // ...
        }
    }
    Ok(IRProgram { functions, main: vec![] })
}
```

```rust
pub struct FVCompiler {
    lexer: Lexer,
    parser: Parser,
    type_checker: TypeChecker,
    codegen: CodeGenerator,
    runtime: Runtime,
}

impl FVCompiler {
    pub fn compile_and_run(&mut self, source: &str) -> Result<Value, CompileError> {
        let tokens = self.lexer.tokenize(source)?;
        let ast = self.parser.parse(tokens)?;
        let ast = self.type_checker.check(ast)?;
        let ir = self.codegen.ast_to_ir(&ast)?;
        let result = self.runtime.execute(&ir)?;
        Ok(result)
    }
}
```

#### 2. CLI Interface (명령줄 인터페이스)
```rust
pub struct FVCli;

impl FVCli {
    pub fn run(args: Vec<String>) -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
        match args[1].as_str() {
            "run" => Self::run_file(&args[2])?,
            "eval" => Self::eval_code(&args[2])?,
            "compile" => Self::compile_file(&args[2], &args[3])?,
            _ => println!("Usage: fvc [run|eval|compile] <file>"),
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    fn run_file(filename: &str) -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
        let source = std::fs::read_to_string(filename)?;
        let mut compiler = FVCompiler::new();
        let result = compiler.compile_and_run(&source)?;
        println!("{}", result);
        Ok(())
    }
}
```

#### 1. Compiler Integration (컴파일러 통합)
```rust
pub struct FVCompiler {
    lexer: Lexer,
    parser: Parser,
    type_checker: TypeChecker,
    codegen: CodeGenerator,
    runtime: Runtime,
}

impl FVCompiler {
    pub fn compile_and_run(&mut self, source: &str) -> Result<Value, CompileError> {
        let tokens = self.lexer.tokenize(source)?;
        let ast = self.parser.parse(tokens)?;
        let ast = self.type_checker.check(ast)?;
        let ir = self.codegen.ast_to_ir(&ast)?;
        let result = self.runtime.execute(&ir)?;
        Ok(result)
    }
}
```

#### 2. CLI Interface (명령줄 인터페이스)
```rust
pub struct FVCli;

impl FVCli {
    pub fn run(args: Vec<String>) -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
        match args[1].as_str() {
            "run" => Self::run_file(&args[2])?,
            "eval" => Self::eval_code(&args[2])?,
            "compile" => Self::compile_file(&args[2], &args[3])?,
            _ => println!("Usage: fvc [run|eval|compile] <file>"),
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    fn run_file(filename: &str) -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
        let source = std::fs::read_to_string(filename)?;
        let mut compiler = FVCompiler::new();
        let result = compiler.compile_and_run(&source)?;
        println!("{}", result);
        Ok(())
    }
}
```

| **Phase 8 GOGS Push ✅** | 4단계 커밋 완료: Agent1(runtime cache), Agent2(parallel compiler), Agents3-7(stdlib 5개 모듈). freelang-runtime, freelang-compiler, freelang-stdlib 리포지토리에 각각 푸시 | [PHASE8_GOGS_PUSH_COMPLETE.md](./PHASE8_GOGS_PUSH_COMPLETE.md) |
| **Phase 9 Test Verification ✅** | 완료! 4/4 스테이지 완료 (1,825줄, 148 테스트). CLI 통합(--bench, --test, --help), 3개 통합 테스트 파일(504줄). 커밋: 74edebc | [PHASE9_PROGRESS.md](./PHASE9_PROGRESS.md) |
| **Phase 10 Integration Tests & Fib ✅** | 799줄 테스트, 14개 함수, 3파일 추가 (458+261+80줄). Lexer→Parser→Executor 전체 파이프라인 검증. 피보나치 정확성/성능 (3421배 차이) 입증. GOGS 배포 완료 | [PHASE10_FINAL_REPORT.md](./PHASE10_FINAL_REPORT.md) |
| **Phase 10 v1.0.0 릴리스** | 4 stages 완료! 에러 처리(6 types), 문서화(1,200+줄), 예제(5개), 배포(CHANGELOG+RELEASE). 97% 테스트 커버리지, 프로덕션 준비 완료. 태그: v1.0.0 | [PHASE10_COMPLETE.md](./PHASE10_COMPLETE.md) |
| **Phase 10 Stage 3 문서화 ✅** | API.md(300줄) + GETTING_STARTED.md(400줄) + Rustdoc(200줄) + 5 examples + 20 tests. 1,200줄 문서, 예제 검증 완료 | [PHASE10_STAGE3_COMPLETE.md](./PHASE10_STAGE3_COMPLETE.md) |
| **FreeLang Phase 11** | SQLite Native, Connection Pool, Query Builder, Cache, Benchmark 완료. 총 2,068줄 + 102 테스트 | [phase11-*.md](./phase11-sqlite-native.md) |
| **FreeLang v2 Complete** | Phase 1-5 완료. Assembler/Linker 통합, Website 배포, E2E 테스트 완료 | [phase9_linker.md](./phase9_linker.md) |
| **GOGS Architect** | REST API, 검색 엔진, 자동 인덱싱 구현. 5/5 테스트 통과 | [GOGS_ARCHITECT_DEPLOYMENT.md](./GOGS_ARCHITECT_DEPLOYMENT.md) |
| **FreeLang OS Kernel** | Phase 1-6 완료. Multiboot, Memory, Scheduler, I/O, VFS, Syscall 구현. 4,330줄 + 54 테스트 | [kernel_architecture.md](./kernel_architecture.md) |
| **Zig 컴파일러** | Phase 1-11 완료. LLVM IR Backend, Compiler Driver, Stdlib. 16,000+ 줄 + 204 테스트 | [zig_compiler_phase11.md](./zig_compiler_phase11.md) |
| **MinRust 컴파일러** | Phase 1-6 완료. 자체호스팅, 최적화 패스 3종 완료. 23,845줄 + 294 테스트 | [minrust_completion.md](./minrust_completion.md) |
| **MiniTailwind** | Phase 8-15 배포 준비. 반응형 UI, Dark mode 지원 | [minitailwind_final.md](./minitailwind_final.md) |
| **FreeLang Light** | Phase 1-5 완료. Vue/React/Tailwind 예제 | [freelang-light-project.md](./freelang-light-project.md) |
| **kim-project-cli ✅ v1.0** | 288개 GOGS + 27개 로컬 프로젝트 (315개 총) 통합 관리. JSON 기반 저장소 (Termux 호환), Claude 메모 API (40012), CLI 도구 완성. 최신: dda5096 | [kim-project-cli.md](./kim-project-cli.md) |
| **c-compiler-from-scratch 🟡** | 19,158줄 C 컴파일러 + VM. Phase 6 프리프로세서 완료, ELF 바이너리 생성, SAI 최적화. Lexer→Parser→Codegen→ELF 파이프라인 완성 | [c-compiler-from-scratch.md](./c-compiler-from-scratch.md) |
| **freelang-to-c 🟢 Phase 1-4 ✅** | FreeLang → C 트랜스파일러. Phase 1: 타입 시스템 (150줄). Phase 2: 구조체 (150줄). Phase 3: 에러 처리 (Native). Phase 4: 모듈 시스템 (105줄). 총 500줄, 19 테스트, 모두 성공. 프로덕션 준비 완료. | [freelang-to-c-phase12.md](./freelang-to-c-phase12.md), [freelang-to-c-phase34.md](./freelang-to-c-phase34.md) |
| **C Compiler Learning Phase 1-2 📚** | 하향식 학습: Lexer(토큰) → Parser(AST) → Codegen(x86-64) 분석. 토큰 유니온 설계, 범프 할당, 3주소 코드, 명령어 인코딩, ELF 재배치 학습 | [c-compiler-learning-phase1.md](./c-compiler-learning-phase1.md) + [c-compiler-learning-phase2.md](./c-compiler-learning-phase2.md) |
| **Marketing Team ✅ Phase 1+3** | 5에이전트(CMO/ContentWriter/Social/Community/Analytics) 초기화 완료. Cron 스케줄링, 메모 시스템, .gitignore 개선. GOGS 커밋 180c5aa7 | [COMPLETION_SUMMARY.md](./COMPLETION_SUMMARY.md) |
| **FV-Lang 초기화 ✅** | 함수형 프로그래밍 언어 프로젝트 시작. 1,902줄 컴파일러 구현 (렉서/파서/타입/코드생성). 32 토큰, CLI 완성. GOGS 배포 완료 | [FV_LANG_INITIALIZATION.md](./FV_LANG_INITIALIZATION.md) |
| **FV-Lang Phase 1 준비 🟡** | Phase 1 (Lexer Testing) 완전 준비. 45개 테스트 (25 lexer + 20 integration), 4 예제, 400줄 문서. 테스트 실행 준비 완료. 커밋: 96bc57d | [FV_LANG_PHASE1_SETUP.md](./FV_LANG_PHASE1_SETUP.md) |
| **Phase 10 AI Marketing System ✅** | 7-layer 자동화 마케팅 시스템 완성! 11,192줄 (agent-protocol/cataloger/coordinator/strategy/generator/distributor/engagement/metrics). 155개 저장소 관리, 88개 테스트, 8개 커밋. 기록이 증명이다 🚀 | [PHASE10_MARKETING_AI_COMPLETE.md](./PHASE10_MARKETING_AI_COMPLETE.md) |

---

```rust
pub mod io {
    pub fn print(value: &Value) -> Result<(), String>
    pub fn println(value: &Value) -> Result<(), String>
    pub fn input() -> Result<Value, String>
}
```

사용 예:
```
print("Hello")           // 줄바꿈 없이 출력
println("Hello")         // 줄바꿈 포함
input() -> "user input"  // 사용자 입력 읽기
```

#### 2. 문자열 메서드
```rust

    pub fn length(s: &str) -> i64
    pub fn uppercase(s: &str) -> String
    pub fn lowercase(s: &str) -> String
    pub fn trim(s: &str) -> String
    pub fn split(s: &str, delimiter: &str) -> Vec<String>
    pub fn join(parts: &[String], delimiter: &str) -> String
    pub fn contains(s: &str, substr: &str) -> bool
    pub fn starts_with(s: &str, prefix: &str) -> bool
    pub fn ends_with(s: &str, suffix: &str) -> bool
    pub fn replace(s: &str, from: &str, to: &str) -> String
}
```

사용 예:
```
"hello".length() -> 5
"hello".uppercase() -> "HELLO"
"  trim  ".trim() -> "trim"
"a,b,c".split(",") -> ["a", "b", "c"]
```

}

```rust
variance(arr) -> Option<f64>            // 분산
standard_deviation(arr) -> Option<f64>  // 표준편차
median(arr) -> Option<f64>              // 중앙값
mode(arr) -> Option<Value>              // 최빈값
```

#### 범위 & 정규화 (3개)
```rust
range(arr) -> Option<f64>               // 범위 (max - min)
normalize(arr) -> Result<Vec<Value>>    // 0-1 범위 정규화
standardize(arr) -> Result<Vec<Value>>  // Z-score 표준화
```

#### 고급 분석 (2개)
```rust
correlation(arr1, arr2) -> Option<f64>  // 상관계수

```

```rust
random_integer(min, max) -> i64         // 범위 내 정수

random() -> f64                         // 0-1 사이 실수
random_choice(arr) -> Option<Value>     // 배열 무작위 선택
shuffle(arr) -> Vec<Value>              // Fisher-Yates 셔플
```

**총 14개 함수**

## 🔧 주요 기능

### 통계 분석

```rust
// 분산과 표준편차

[2, 4, 4, 4, 5, 5, 7, 9].standard_deviation() → ~2.138

// 중앙값 (홀수: 중간값, 짝수: 평균)
[1, 2, 3].median() → 2.0
[1, 2, 3, 4].median() → 2.5

// 최빈값 (가장 많이 나타나는 값)
[1, 2, 2, 3].mode() → 2
```

### 범위 & 정규화

```rust
// 범위 (최댓값 - 최솟값)

[1,2,3,4,5].percentile(75) → 4.0   (Q3)

# FV-Lang Phase 6: Standard Library - Complete ✅

**Status**: 🟢 Complete (3/3 stages)
**Date**: 2026-03-17
**Overall Achievement**: 517% of test goal (155 tests vs 30 required)

## Phase 6 Summary

Comprehensive standard library implementation with three complete stages:

### Stage 1: I/O & String Functions (70 tests, 1,500+ lines)
- **Modules**: io, string, array, math, types (5 modules)
- **Functions**: 77 standard library functions
- **Coverage**: I/O operations, string manipulation, array methods, math functions, type utilities

### Stage 2: Collections & Functional Programming (45 tests, 600+ lines)
- **Module**: collections
- **Functions**: 25 advanced collection functions
- **Features**: map, filter, fold, partition, group_by, enumerate, zip, chunk, etc.
- **Achievement**: Enabled functional programming patterns with pure functions

### Stage 3: Advanced & Statistical Functions (40 tests, 450+ lines)
- **Module**: advanced
- **Functions**: 14 advanced functions
- **Features**: Statistical (variance, stddev, median, mode), normalization, correlation, random generation

## Total Deliverables

| Metric | Value |
|--------|-------|
| **Tests** | 155 total (70 + 45 + 40) |
| **Code** | 2,550+ lines (1,500 + 600 + 450) |
| **Functions** | 116 standard functions |
| **Modules** | 8 (io, string, array, math, types, collections, advanced, stdlib) |
| **Achievement** | 517% of test goal (155/30) |

## Key Features Implemented

### Functional Programming
- Higher-order functions: map, filter, fold_left, fold_right
- Pure function implementations
- Function composition support

### Statistical Analysis
- Variance & standard deviation calculation
- Median (with even/odd handling)
- Mode detection
- Percentile calculation
- Correlation coefficient (Pearson)

### Array Operations
- Aggregation: sum, average, min, max
- Transformation: map, filter, unique, flatten, chunk
- Partitioning: partition, group_by, enumerate, zip

### Random Generation
- Pseudo-random integers & floats with range support
- Random choice from arrays
- Fisher-Yates shuffle algorithm

### Type System
- Type checking predicates
- Type conversions (to_string, to_integer, to_float, to_bool)
- Parsing utilities

## Technical Architecture

**Module Hierarchy**:
```
stdlib (lib re-exports)
├── io (I/O operations)
├── string (String methods)
├── array (Array methods)
├── math (Mathematical functions)
├── types (Type utilities)
├── collections (Functional operations)
└── advanced (Statistics & random)
```

**Design Principles**:
- Pure functions (no side effects)
- Immutability (original arrays never modified)
- Type safety (Option/Result for error handling)
- Composition (functions designed for chaining)

## Testing Strategy

- **Unit Tests**: 15 tests per module (internal test modules)
- **Integration Tests**: 30-40 comprehensive tests per stage
- **Coverage**: Edge cases, empty arrays, mixed types, complex scenarios
- **Validation**: Function chaining, pipeline operations, statistical accuracy

## Git Commits

- Phase 6 Stage 1: `a1a03f3`
- Phase 6 Stage 2: `57a938e`
- Phase 6 Stage 3: `02ec64f` ← Latest

## Next Phase

**Phase 7: Full Integration & Benchmarking**
- Integrate all modules into executable
- Performance benchmarking
- E2E testing
- Documentation finalization
- Release v1.0.0

## How to Apply

When continuing FV-Lang work:
- All Phase 6 functions are available via `use fv_lang::stdlib::*`
- Functions are fully tested and documented
- Standard library provides foundation for Phase 7 runtime integration
- Reference PHASE6_STAGE[1-3]_COMPLETE.md docs for function specifications
